traits.sympodium.note: King's American Dispensatory (1898 text, 1905 printing), vol. 2, Tabacum, p. 1907 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): the flowers in panicles at the ends of the stems and branches, the stem branched only toward its top.

traits.inflorescence.note: King's American Dispensatory (1898 text, 1905 printing), vol. 2, Tabacum, p. 1907 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): flowers in terminal panicles; Bailey (vol. 4, p. 2143) for the genus: flowers in bracted panicles or racemes.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of British India vol. 4 (Clarke, 1883-85), Nicotiana (genus account), p. 245 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): capsule 2-celled, 2-valved to the middle.

traits.leaf_division.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 4 (1914-17), Nicotiana (genus account), p. 2143 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): leaves alternate, never compound, entire or wavy, mostly sessile or nearly so.

traits.capsule_valves.note: Flora of British India vol. 4 (Clarke, 1883-85), Nicotiana (genus account), p. 245 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): capsule 2-celled, 2-valved to the middle; King's American Dispensatory (vol. 2, Tabacum): 2-valved, opening across the top.
